title: Service Account — Create Request
description: Request body for POST /api/pact/service-accounts (§22.3). The response returns the pact_sa_ key exactly once; servers store only a hash (§22.1). Scope dimensions are narrowing; an omitted dimension is unrestricted within the others. Added in PACT v2.1 (§22).

display_name.description: Human-readable label (e.g. the daemon or CI job name).

owner_principal_id.description: The §17.4 principal accountable for this key.

resource_id.description: Per-resource scope. "*" grants all resources the owner can reach — servers SHOULD warn on wildcard grants.

sections.description: Per-section scope within the resource (§14 field addressing, e.g. sec:intro).

operations.description: Per-operation allow-list (§7.1 / §13.6 / §19.3 operation names, e.g. join, intent, constrain, poll).

mandate_digest.description: Per-mandate scope: key valid only for operations under the Mandate whose §20.3 canonical SHA-256 digest matches. Ties a daemon's key to one Parley's authority.
